# GitHub mirror assets

These images are used **only** by [`.github/README.md`](../README.md), which GitHub renders as the landing page for [github.com/droptica/openintranet](https://github.com/droptica/openintranet).

They are **not** part of the Open Intranet distribution and are excluded from Composer release tarballs via [`.gitattributes`](../../.gitattributes) (`.github/ export-ignore`).

## Current files

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `screenshot-home.png` | Hero — Home dashboard (featured news banner, highlighted links, news feed, upcoming events) |
| `screenshot-news-feed.png` | News feed view |
| `screenshot-documents.png` | Document detail view with preview, metadata and access controls |
| `screenshot-knowledge-base.png` | Knowledge Base page with Book sidebar navigation |
| `screenshot-ai-assistant.png` | AI Assistant generating content for a knowledge base page |
| `screenshot-people-directory.png` | Employee directory |

When replacing a screenshot, keep the **same filename** so that [`.github/README.md`](../README.md) does not need to be updated.
